summary: Local HTTP/WebRTC bridge contract for WhatsApp Calling and voice streaming experiments.

health.description: Return process health, active call IDs, and the fixed audio shape.

offer.description: Create or replace a call session from a remote SDP offer and return a local SDP answer.

call_status.description: Inspect a live call session and queue depths.

query.max_bytes: Positive byte count aligned to whole s16le samples. Defaults to audio.default_drain_bytes and is capped by audio.max_inbound_queue_bytes.
query.wait_ms: Optional non-negative long-poll timeout. Capped by audio.max_drain_wait_ms.

receive_audio.description: Drain decoded inbound PCM from a live call session.

send_audio.description: Queue outbound PCM for a live call session.

close_call.description: Close and remove a live call session.

send_audio_request.pcm_s16le_base64: Required base64 encoded signed 16-bit little-endian mono PCM.

receive_audio_response.returned_bytes: Number of decoded PCM bytes returned.
receive_audio_response.queued_rx_bytes: Remaining inbound decoded PCM bytes queued after this drain.
receive_audio_response.pcm_s16le_base64: Base64 encoded signed 16-bit little-endian mono PCM.
receive_audio_response.audio: Fixed audio shape: sample_rate, channels, frame_ms, encoding.
